comment: Frozen official ACP baseline for the echo-agent SDK contract. The three version layers are governed independently (design §18): the wire protocol version negotiated via initialize.protocolVersion, the official Rust crate versions, and the schema artifact version. Draft/unstable ACP capabilities (including protocol v2) are intentionally excluded; tests assert the lockfile matches this file and that the official crate's latest stable wire version is 1.

schema_artifact.note: The official schema crate is the only wire authority; this repository never copies or regenerates official ACP schemas.
